steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: These guys... aren't so strong, but they really don't know when to stop.
Your keen eyes notice a small group of gangsters sneaking away—It's a feint attack. They're trying to sneak around the back. One of them looks very familiar to you.
You didn't wait for Iron's answer before you lead the Sinners away quickly and eventually blocked the prowlers in the alley next to the hospital.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Haha! I knew the Chief would notice our plan.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I'm here to save you, Chief.
steps.female_content: I'm here to save you, Ms. Chief.
